_comment: Per-sender permissions. Known senders listed here; anyone else gets guest_defaults (approval-required T3 runtime mode + blocking pps screen, fail-closed). When pps declines a guest message the bot @-mentions every owner in the thread; an owner replying a bare Yes/No permits or keeps the denial. Delete this file to turn protection off entirely (everyone owner, pre-pps behavior). pps_mode: skip | log | enforce. t3_model (optional, non-owners only): the T3 model for threads that sender STARTS; unset = guest_defaults, then the built-in Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5). Owners always use the channel's t3_model. T3 fixes a thread's model at creation, so a reply from someone else never changes it. Find a user's id: click their profile in Slack > three dots > Copy member ID.
